keyEvents.text: Delay in match because of an injury Kerim Alajbegovic (Juventus).
Delay over. They are ready to continue.
Substitution, Juventus. Nick Woltemade replaces Kerim Alajbegovic.
Substitution, Juventus. Pape Matar Sarr replaces Douglas Luiz.
Goal! Juventus 1, Venezia 0. Nick Woltemade (Juventus) right footed shot from very close range to the high centre of the goal.
Goal! Juventus 2, Venezia 0. Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) left footed shot from the centre of the box to the bottom right corner. Assisted by Nick Woltemade.

Goal! Juventus 3, Venezia 0. Juan Cabal (Juventus) header from very close range to the high centre of the goal. Assisted by Edon Zhegrova with a cross following a corner.Goal confirmed following VAR Review.
Substitution, Venezia. Matteo Dagasso replaces Simon Sohm.
Substitution, Venezia. John Yeboah replaces Lion Lauberbach.
Substitution, Juventus. Federico Gatti replaces Zeki Çelik.
Goal! Juventus 4, Venezia 0. Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) converts the penalty with a right footed shot to the bottom right corner.
Substitution, Juventus. Andrea Cambiaso replaces Juan Cabal.
Substitution, Venezia. Lamine Fanne replaces Kike Pérez.
Substitution, Venezia. Richie Sagrado replaces Antoine Hainaut.
Substitution, Juventus. Jérémie Boga replaces Randal Kolo Muani.
Substitution, Venezia. Albion Rrahmani replaces Akor Adams.
